zh: 虽然路上堵车，至少我没迟到。
old_en: At least I didn't get stuck in the traffic.
new_en: At least I didn't miss the deadline despite the traffic.

zh: 至少还能坐公交车。
old_en: At least you can still take the bus.
new_en: At least you can still take the bus.

zh: 这个价格虽然不便宜，至少不会让你心疼。
old_en: At least it's not so expensive that it hurts.
new_en: It's pricey, but at least it won't hurt your wallet.

zh: 最后还是决定去爬山。
old_en: In the end, we decided to go hiking.
new_en: In the end, I decided to go hiking.

zh: 犹豫了很久，最后还是决定不去。
old_en: In the end, I decided not to go.
new_en: After much thought, I decided not to go.

zh: 至少天气不错，今天可以不用带伞。
old_en: At least the weather is nice, so you don't need an umbrella.
new_en: At least the weather is nice, so you don't need an umbrella.

zh: 虽然有点风，至少天气还不错。
old_en: At least the weather isn't too bad, despite the wind.
new_en: It's a bit windy, but at least the weather is still good.

zh: 毕竟工作还是要做的。
old_en: After all, I had to go to work.
new_en: After all, work still needs to be done.

zh: 毕竟答应别人的事情不能不履行。
old_en: At least I kept my promise.
new_en: After all, I kept my promise.

zh: 最后还是买了这本教科书。
old_en: In the end, I did buy that textbook.
new_en: In the end, I bought the textbook.

zh: 最后还是没买那双鞋子。
old_en: In the end, I didn't buy those shoes.
new_en: In the end, I didn't buy the shoes.

zh: 至少比上次多卖了一些。
old_en: At least it sold better than last time.
new_en: At least it sold more than last time.

zh: 至少这次考试比上次好一些。
old_en: At least this time's exam was better than last time.
new_en: At least I did better on this test than last time.

zh: 最后还是说了真话，虽然有点害怕。
old_en: In the end, at least I told the truth and no longer feel guilty.
new_en: In the end, I told the truth even though I was scared.

zh: 虽然开会晚到了一点，至少没耽误正事。
old_en: At least we didn't miss the important parts of the meeting.
new_en: Although I was late for the meeting, at least I didn't miss the important parts.

zh: 虽然加班很晚，至少赶上了末班车。
old_en: In the end, although he worked late, he at least caught the last bus.
new_en: Even though I worked late, I at least caught the last bus.

zh: 最后总算赶上了公交，不然就要晚半小时到公司。
old_en: In the end, I managed to catch the bus, otherwise I would have been half an hour late for work.
new_en: In the end, I managed to catch the bus, otherwise I'd be half an hour late for work.

zh: 毕竟第一次做这个项目，犯点错误也是正常的。
old_en: After all, it's only natural to make mistakes on the first attempt.
new_en: After all, it's my first time, so making mistakes is normal.

zh: 毕竟是第一次上台，我紧张得不行。
old_en: After all, it was my first time on stage, and I was really nervous.
new_en: It's my first time on stage, so I'm really nervous.

zh: 毕竟说了实话，至少不用心虚了。
old_en: After all, at least he told the truth and no longer feels guilty.
new_en: I told the truth, so at least I don't feel guilty anymore.
